name: f007-flow-stability-scan-retarget
title: Retarget flow-stability test #7 import-isolation scan to done-oracle.ts
description: Retarget the flow-stability-smoke.ts import-isolation guard (section (7), the B-4b22 preMortem #3 anchor) so it scans the real dirty-gate-policy consumer. The guard greps a hardcoded file list — currently ['handlers/story-advance.ts', 'core/validation-executor.ts'] — asserting DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES literals only ever arrive via import from dirty-gate-policy.js, never inlined. After the transition-orchestrator refactor, handlers/story-advance.ts is a thin handler that no longer imports or consumes those category literals, so the guard empty-scans it; the actual evaluateDirtyGate consumer core/done-oracle.ts is left unscanned. Fix: replace 'handlers/story-advance.ts' in the scan list with 'core/done-oracle.ts'. There is no current literal drift (done-oracle.ts correctly imports from dirty-gate-policy.js / dirty-worktree.js), so the test stays green after the retarget — this is a verified-low test-aim correction, not a bug fix. Out of scope: restructuring the guard, touching the dirty-gate-policy module, or any other flow-stability test.
